subject: Money
title: Worker Ownership
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Worker Ownership.

hook.text: Mondragon in Spain is a worker-owned cooperative with 80,000 employees and $14 billion in revenue.

buildup.text: In cooperatives, workers own shares and vote on major decisions. Profits are shared, not extracted by shareholders.

discovery.text: Employee stock ownership plans (ESOPs) give workers equity. Companies with ESOPs have 25% higher productivity.

twist.text: Worker ownership has limits: it's hard to raise capital without outside investors, and growth can be slower.

climax.text: Ownership is the difference between earning a wage and building wealth. Workers who own share in the upside.

punchline.text: Own the company. Share the wealth.

quiz.question: What is the productivity effect of employee stock ownership plans?
